notes: No new stories created to avoid duplication. Existing set already satisfies required breakdown (schema, core logic, API, tests, integration). Minor evidence refinement applied.

change_log.note: Made evidence explicit to concrete facade implementations

MAINT-ARCH-S1.title: Define Service Boundaries and Contracts
MAINT-ARCH-S1.description: Define explicit service interfaces, data contracts, and module boundaries for the 4-layer modular monolith (facades, domain services, infrastructure, adapters) per ARCH-001.

MAINT-ARCH-S2.title: Refactor Domain Logic into Isolated Services
MAINT-ARCH-S2.description: Extract and reorganize existing domain logic (provider search, evaluate care, shared services) into isolated, stateless service modules aligned with defined contracts.

MAINT-ARCH-S3.title: Align Facades and API Layer to Service Contracts
MAINT-ARCH-S3.description: Refactor FastAPI entrypoints and application facades (find_care_facade, evaluate_care_facade) to consume newly defined service interfaces without direct domain coupling.

MAINT-ARCH-S4.title: Refactor Unit and Integration Test Coverage
MAINT-ARCH-S4.description: Update and expand unit and integration tests to validate new module boundaries, service contracts, and facade interactions without regression.

MAINT-ARCH-S5.title: Rewire Application Bootstrap and Service Registration
MAINT-ARCH-S5.description: Update main.py wiring to register services, enforce dependency direction (no circular dependencies), and ensure clean initialization aligned with modular monolith design.
